email.subject1: a signal play for Vision Group
email.body1:
Samantha, saw Vision Group unify planning, execution, and image recognition into one brand after the Maxerience, SMSB, and Hivery acquisitions.

Bringing that many products under one story usually means more in-market CPG accounts than BD can personally touch before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Vision Group off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Samantha, quick follow-up for Vision Group.

With the unified platform live across 55+ countries, the question is how many meetings BD needs to book to keep pipeline ahead of the expanded story, and most teams find the gap late. More reps alone rarely closes it in time.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Vision Group needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.
email.body3:
Samantha, last bit of proof for Vision Group.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Vision Group's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Samantha, I will stop reaching out here, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not the priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and I know integrating three acquisitions into one brand is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Vision Group either way.
